in_marathi.name: Dhana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhana is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘dhan’, which means wealth, fortune, or prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Dhana is considered the goddess of wealth and is often depicted holding a pot of gold coins or sitting on a lotus. She is believed to bless her devotees with financial success and abundance.
